import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
print("Archive contents:")
for n in z.namelist():
    print(" ", n)

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', NS):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))

print("\nShared strings count:", len(shared))

sheetfile = 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'
root = ET.fromstring(z.read(sheetfile))
sd = root.find('m:sheetData', NS)
print("Sheet1 rows:", len(sd.findall('m:row', NS)))
for row in sd.findall('m:row', NS)[:15]:
    vals = []
    for c in row.findall('m:c', NS):
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', NS)
        val = ''
        if v is not None:
            val = v.text
            if t == 's':
                idx = int(val)
                val = shared[idx] if idx < len(shared) else f'<{idx}>'
            elif t == 'inlineStr':
                is_ = c.find('m:is', NS)
                if is_ is not None:
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        vals.append(f"{ref}={val}")
    print(" | ".join(vals))

import os
import tempfile
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    names = zin.namelist()
    items = {n: zin.read(n) for n in names}

# ---------- sheet1.xml ----------
root = ET.fromstring(items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
sd = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')
rows = sd.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row')

def make_cell(ref, style=None, cell_type=None):
    attrs = {'r': ref}
    if style is not None:
        attrs['s'] = style
    if cell_type is not None:
        attrs['t'] = cell_type
    return ET.Element(f'{{{NS}}}c', attrs)

# Header cell H1
h1 = make_cell('H1', style='1', cell_type='inlineStr')
is_el = ET.SubElement(h1, f'{{{NS}}}is')
t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, f'{{{NS}}}t')
t_el.text = 'Profit Margin'
rows[0].append(h1)

# Data rows 2-9 and TOTAL row 10: profit margin = profit / revenue
for row in rows[1:]:
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    c = make_cell(f'H{r}', style='3')
    f_el = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f')
    f_el.text = f'G{r}/E{r}'
    ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}v')
    row.append(c)

# Update dimension
dim = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}dimension')
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

# Add column width for H
cols = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}cols')
col = ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS}}}col')
col.set('width', '12')
col.set('customWidth', '1')
col.set('min', '8')
col.set('max', '8')

sheet_xml = ET.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')

# ---------- styles.xml ----------
sroot = ET.fromstring(items['xl/styles.xml'])

numfmts = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}numFmts')
numfmts.set('count', '1')
nf = ET.SubElement(numfmts, f'{{{NS}}}numFmt')
nf.set('numFmtId', '164')
nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%')

cellxfs = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}cellXfs')
cellxfs.set('count', '4')
xf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf')
xf.set('numFmtId', '164')
xf.set('fontId', '0')
xf.set('fillId', '0')
xf.set('borderId', '0')
xf.set('pivotButton', '0')
xf.set('quotePrefix', '0')
xf.set('xfId', '0')

styles_xml = ET.tostring(sroot, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')

# ---------- write new archive ----------
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='.', suffix='.xlsx')
os.close(fd)
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n in names:
        data = items[n]
        if n == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = sheet_xml
        elif n == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = styles_xml
        zout.writestr(n, data)
os.replace(tmp, SRC)

# Quick verification of written XML
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    content = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
print('H1 present:', 'Profit Margin' in content)
print('H2 formula present:', '<f>G2/E2</f>' in content)
print('H10 formula present:', '<f>G10/E10</f>' in content)
print('dimension:', 'A1:H10' in content)
